input.summary: Delete the Customer exclusive-dealing/non-compete covenant in the second Section 12.4 and confirm Vendor is a non-exclusive provider.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a covenant barring us from acquiring or developing competing products or services for the term plus twenty-four months, which would make Cobalt our de facto exclusive supplier; our playbook position is no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the customer, consistent with Section 12.3. We have deleted it and confirmed Vendor's non-exclusive status.

ops.oldText: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
ops.newText: Vendor is a non-exclusive provider of the Services. Customer is free to develop, market, sell, acquire, and use any product or service, including one that competes with Vendor, and to procure services from any other supplier at any time.
